notes:
- LOADOUT (Gunsmith) on the main menu: pick a gun, choose its camo and attachments, see a 3D preview
  and how each attachment changes its stats. Whenever you get that gun in a game (wall, box, upgrade),
  it comes with your camo and attachments.
- Gun levels: every gun levels up (1-20) from kills with it (headshots give more XP); a banner shows
  when a gun levels up and what it unlocked. Attachments unlock as the gun levels up.
- More guns to customize as your player level goes up (pistol and SMG from the start, the Cryo
  Freezer at level 25).
- 5 attachment slots, all visible on the gun: Optic (Red Dot, Holographic) on guns with iron sights,
  Muzzle (Suppressor, Compensator), Barrel (Long, Heavy), Magazine (Extended, Fast Mag) and Grip/Stock
  (Vertical Grip, Padded Stock).
- Camos are now picked per gun in the Gunsmith (your old camo choice carries over to every gun).
  Teammates see the camo you picked on the gun you're holding.
- 6 new Mystery Box guns: Stalker 12 (pump shotgun), Warden DMR (marksman rifle), Mag-50 (heavy
  handgun), Hornet PDW (compact SMG), Buzzsaw (minigun: spins up, then shreds) and Bolt Thrower
  (crossbow firing fast, flat explosive bolts). Each has an upgraded version.
